description: Neural web search via the Exa API backend. Use for searches that need date filtering, domain targeting, category scoping, or neural semantic search quality. Exa is the default search backend — Firecrawl handles page extraction and crawling. Triggers on: "exa search", "find recent papers on", "search arxiv for",  "find news from last month about", "search github for", "research papers about", any search that needs date ranges, domain filtering, or content-type scoping.
